services.name: Sprinkler repair
services.blurb: Broken heads, dry spots and zones that won't come on, fixed on the first visit when we can.

services.name: Freeze repair
services.blurb: Split pipes and cracked backflow devices after a hard freeze, found and replaced.

services.name: Winterization
services.blurb: Water shut off, backflow drained and wrapped before the first North Texas freeze.

services.name: Spring start-up
services.blurb: System turned back on, every zone checked, and the schedule set for your watering days.

services.name: Backflow testing
services.blurb: Yearly backflow test sent to your city, plus repair if the device fails.

services.name: Foundation drip lines
services.blurb: A drip line along the slab on its own zone, so the clay gets steady water in August.

services.name: Smart controller setup
services.blurb: Controller programmed to your city's watering days and changed when the rules change.

services.name: New sprinkler system
services.blurb: A full system laid out for St. Augustine or Bermuda, shade beds and heavy clay.

services.name: Rain and freeze sensors
services.blurb: A sensor that stops the system from running in rain or on near-freezing mornings.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: After the February freeze our backflow was split right down the side. Dale's crew had it replaced two days later, while half the street was still waiting on somebody to call back.
reviews.name: Kristen J.

reviews.text: They winterize us every November and turn it back on in March. I don't think about it anymore, which is the whole point.
reviews.name: Bob T.

reviews.text: Our clay pulls away from the slab every August. They ran a drip line along the foundation on its own zone, and this summer the gap along the patio stayed closed.
reviews.name: Leticia M.

reviews.text: Simple job, two heads broken by the mower. Showed up when they said, fixed both, and the bill matched what they told me on the phone.
reviews.name: Greg D.

reviews.text: We moved here from Ohio and had no idea what watering days were. They set the controller and wrote our days on a card taped inside the garage door. Nice touch.
reviews.name: Hannah C.

reviews.text: New system for our new build. They laid out the heads around the young live oak and the beds, kept the spray off the brick, and the St. Augustine came in thick by June.
reviews.name: Ray O.

proof.guarantee: If a repair we made leaks or fails within a year, we come back and fix it at no charge.
